title: Amen Thompson agrees to 5-year rookie-scale extension with Rockets: Source
content:
Amen Thompson has agreed to a five-year, $208 million rookie-scale contract extension with the Houston Rockets, a team source confirmed to The Athletic on Thursday.

The source spoke on the condition of anonymity because the deal, which includes a 10 percent trade kicker, was not yet official. ESPN first reported the extension, which will kick in beginning with the 2027-28 season.

Thompson, the fourth pick in the 2023 NBA Draft, started 79 games for the Rockets last season and averaged a career-high 18.3 points and 5.3 assists per game. The 23-year-old has finished top 10 in Defensive Player of the Year voting in each of the last two seasons and served as one of Houston’s primary ballhandlers last season after point guard Fred VanVleet tore his ACL over the summer.

This story will be updated.
